name: driver_of_the_dead_offers_only_your_two_drops
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature dies, return target creature card with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Driver of the Dead dies. Seat 0's graveyard holds a creature card of mana value 2 and one of mana value 1 (legal), one of mana value 3 (too high) and a noncreature artifact card of mana value 1; the opponent's graveyard holds a mana value 1 creature card (not your graveyard). The step answers no target, so it stops at the target ask: it offers card:1 and card:2 (Grave Two and Grave One, the setup's second and third cards) and nothing else.
